whatIs.title: What Are Dental Implants?
whatIs.p1: Dental implants are titanium screws surgically placed in the jawbone to replace missing teeth roots. They provide a strong foundation for fixed or removable replacement teeth that match your natural teeth.
whatIs.p2: The implant integrates with the jawbone to become a permanent part of your mouth, providing superior stability and functionality compared to traditional dentures or bridges.

item1.desc: Implants look and feel like natural teeth, restoring your beautiful smile

item2.title: Improved Function
item2.desc: Eat, speak, and smile with confidence without worrying about slipping

item3.title: Bone Preservation
item3.desc: Prevents bone loss and maintains facial structure

item4.title: Durability
item4.desc: With proper care, implants can last a lifetime

item5.title: Oral Health
item5.desc: Doesn't require altering adjacent teeth like bridges do

item6.title: High Success Rate
item6.desc: Success rate exceeds 95% with modern techniques

step4.desc: Connecting piece attached to implant to support the crown

step5.desc: Custom-made crown placed on abutment, matching your natural teeth

hybridVeneers.title: Hybrid Veneers - Perfect Smile Solution
hybridVeneers.lead: Combine the best of both worlds with hybrid veneers. Strong like porcelain, flexible like composite, and perfect for your smile.
hybridVeneers.imageAlt: Hybrid Veneers service at Dr. Fayed Dental Clinic

whatIs.title: What Are Hybrid Veneers?
whatIs.p1: Hybrid veneers represent the latest advancement in cosmetic dentistry, combining the strength and aesthetics of porcelain with the flexibility and repairability of composite resin. This innovative material offers superior durability while maintaining a natural appearance.
whatIs.p2: The unique composition allows for minimal tooth preparation, making the procedure less invasive while delivering exceptional results that can last for many years with proper care.

item1.desc: Requires less tooth reduction than traditional veneers

item4.desc: Can be easily repaired if damaged

threeNVeneers.title: 3N Veneers - Ultra-Thin Perfection
threeNVeneers.lead: Experience the latest in veneer technology with 3N veneers. Ultra-thin, ultra-strong, and ultra-beautiful results without tooth preparation.
threeNVeneers.imageAlt: 3N Veneers service at Dr. Fayed Dental Clinic

whatIs.title: What Are 3N Veneers?
whatIs.p1: 3N Veneers are the newest generation of ultra-thin porcelain veneers, typically just 0.3mm thick. They're designed to be bonded directly to your natural teeth with minimal to no tooth preparation, preserving your natural tooth structure.
whatIs.p2: Using advanced ceramic technology, 3N veneers offer exceptional strength despite their thinness, providing a natural-looking smile transformation that's both beautiful and durable.
